## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can configure exclusions through the environment.

## Changes

The pull request adds and documents a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file names and logs skipped paths in verbose mode. It adds tests for parsing and archive contents, along with an adversarial text fixture.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser uses `default=[]` and the archive includes `debug.log`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that every new CLI flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable.” — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment will include files they intended to skip.
